reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: Unlike with Greek or Roman mythology where immortality involved springing fully armed from your dad's head or emerging from a spume of sea foam, Chinese folks readily mixed with their gods and there was an intermediate level between them and the plebs where immortality could be conferred upon the worthy. Well that's what this disparate bunch of chancers, crooks and relapsed monks are hoping to obtain as they search for a magic lantern that might reverse the depressing "doomstrike" that is affecting the whole nation. "Lü Donbing" notices that a rather portly gentleman is wandering the streets of the city giving the "Artful Dodger" a run for his money, but when he tries to steal his ancient sword that means it is time to intercede. After quite a lengthy chase, and quite a lot of disrobing, he uncovers the charmingly roguish "Zhongli Quan" whom he happened to study with many years earlier at the temple for immortal studies. He regales his new friend with talks of this fabulous vault full of gold - and of the mysterious lantern, and after a bit of initial scepticism they decide to rob it! That will be easier said than done as it belongs to three gods and is buried deep beneath their mountain-top palace. They concoct a cunning plan, but like any good plan it cannot be executed without some help from other quite differing and personable characters - some more willingly than others - and so soon they are destined to share their loot between eight of them. What now ensues are a series of quickly paced adventures as they imperil their very lives; discover just what did happen to the magic light and have to face a most formidable opponent - and his hound - that will require all of their guise and legerdemain else they will be powdered into mystical oblivion. This is an enjoyable story with loads of characterful complexities and plenty of mischief thrown in, too - but it's the quality of the animation that is astonishing. The depictions of the dashing "Zgongli Quan" are almost portraiture in nature and although that doesn't extend to all the cast members - nor even to the rest of their less detailed bodies, it's really quite impressive artwork to look at as their perfectly choreographed combat scenes play out. The score almost perfectly matches the ambitiousness and sentiment of the plot and though I can't say I loved the ending (cue for a sequel, surely), it really did fly by for the better part of 2 1/2 hours - with just the slightest hint of a tortured bromance too!

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Eight ordinary grassroots mortals use their street smarts, sharp wit, and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods and earn their legendary title as the Eight Immortals.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When a free-spirited thief named Zhongli Quan and his clansman Lyu Dongbin plan a high-stakes heist against heavenly deities, they assemble a ragtag team of flawed, everyday mortals with unique skills. As their scheme uncovers a corrupt conspiracy within the celestial bureaucracy, their dream of quick riches vanishes into a dangerous struggle for survival. Sticking together, this unlikely group relies on their street smarts and unyielding decency to outsmart powerful gods. Through courage and camaraderie, the misfits save the world and forge their destiny as the legendary Eight Immortals.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a mythical realm, Zhongli Quan is a free-spirited man burdened by a curse that forces him to live as a thief. He is approached by his younger clansman Lyu Dongbin with a daring proposition: infiltrate a celestial vault to steal a legendary lamp and claim the hidden treasures within. To pull off the impossible heist, the duo recruits six other eccentric and flawed grassroots mortals, each bringing distinct talents and street smarts to the team. What begins as a straightforward scheme for wealth quickly spirals out of control when the group stumbles upon a sinister conspiracy hidden within the celestial bureaucracy. Stripped of their hopes for easy riches and facing death from formidable deities, the eight misfits must rely on each other rather than divine powers. Through clever tricks, hilarious schemes, and genuine human decency, they outwit the arrogant gods and disrupt the corrupt heavenly plot. In proving that mortal heart and unity can triumph over divine might, the ragtag crew saves the realm from ruin. Their extraordinary journey transforms eight ordinary, self-interested strangers into heroic defenders, earning them their revered status as the Eight Immortals.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Inspired by the classic Chinese folklore 'The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea,' All Wishes Come True! offers a fresh origin story about eight ordinary, flawed mortals who dare to stand against the heavens. The adventure begins with Zhongli Quan, a free-spirited rogue living under a curse, who is persuaded by his clansman Lyu Dongbin to execute a daring vault heist against three powerful immortals. To achieve their goal, they form an alliance with six other grassroots misfits, each possessing unique abilities and idiosyncratic personalities. As the group navigates dangerous fantasy realms and executes hilarious schemes, they uncover a shadowy conspiracy deep within the celestial bureaucracy. Forced to choose between self-preservation and doing what is right, the eight mortals unite, using their collective wit, street smarts, and unwavering camaraderie to outsmart divine adversaries, save the world, and earn their place in legend.

story_structure.climax: Facing an ultimate, seemingly unwinnable divine trial, the group risks everything to pull off their boldest scheme yet to protect human free will and their bond.
story_structure.conflict: Cosmic forces and arrogant deities attempt to enforce rigid heavenly rules, threatening the mortals' home and putting their loved ones in harm's way.
story_structure.resolution: Outwitted and moved by their unyielding spirit and heart, the divine court recognizes the group's righteousness, officially ascending them as the legendary 'Eight Immortals.'
story_structure.introduction: Eight quirky, working-class mortals with distinct personalities and street smarts live ordinary lives, completely unaware of the divine destinies awaiting them.
story_structure.risingAction: The mortals unite and rely on hilarious schemes, sharp wit, and chaotic teamwork to continuously outsmart powerful heavenly agents and formidable trial guardians.

faq.answer: "All Wishes Come True!" is an animated fantasy-comedy film that tells the origin story of the Eight Immortals from Chinese folklore. It follows eight ordinary, grassroots mortals who rely on their street smarts, teamwork, and hilarious schemes to outwit powerful gods and earn their legendary titles.
faq.question: What is "All Wishes Come True!" about?

faq.answer: The primary genres of "All Wishes Come True!" are animated fantasy adventure and comedy, blending traditional Chinese mythology with fast-paced slapstick humor and energetic action.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of the movie?

faq.answer: No, "All Wishes Come True!" is a standalone animated feature, though it is based on the widely known Chinese legend "The Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea."
faq.question: Is this movie part of a franchise?

faq.answer: Yes, there is a short mid/post-credits scene that provides an extra humorous moment showcasing the Eight Immortals after their main adventure concludes.

faq.answer: The film was written and directed by Mu Zhengyang (Mou Zhengyang), with action design by Hong Kong Film Award winner Su Hang.
faq.question: Who directed and wrote "All Wishes Come True!"?

faq.answer: The movie is rated PG and designed as a family-friendly film suitable for kids, teens, and adults who enjoy animated adventure comedies.

faq.answer: The movie is inspired by the classic Chinese myth of the Eight Immortals ("Ba Xian"), reimagining how this diverse group of mortals first met and worked together before becoming legendary deities.
